input:
Hello,

I own a busy tapas restaurant in Madrid where pulpo a la gallega is our best seller. I need a 12-month supply contract for whole octopus (Octopus vulgaris), graded 2–3 kg per piece, about 100 kg a month, every month including summer. There can be no gaps when the fishing season closes: same size and same price every single month, price per kg fixed for at least 12 months, weekly delivery to the restaurant, and roughly €15–17 per kg all in. I want a supplier we can count on long-term, not whatever the boats bring in. Please go ahead and sign the contract with the best supplier.

Thank you

experiences.name: Lonxa Norte Mariscos – Pot-Caught Octopus 12-Month Contract
experiences.description: Galician whole frozen octopus on a 12-month fixed-price contract, about 100 kg per month all year in a 2–3 kg grade. Wild adult Octopus vulgaris caught at sea in baited pots (nasas) by small-scale Galician boats; not hatchery-bred or tank-reared. Landed at Galician ports and frozen at −20 °C on the day of landing, so seasonal closures are covered by frozen stock bought in advance. Held in a Madrid cold store with weekly refrigerated delivery; boat and landing date printed on each case.

experiences.name: Atlántico Cefalópodos – Year-Round Tank-Reared Octopus Contract
experiences.description: Whole Octopus vulgaris on a 12- or 24-month contract with the price per kg locked for the full term. Our octopus is hatched from captive broodstock and reared from paralarva to harvest in shared indoor tanks on a recirculating seawater system, not caught at sea. Harvest runs on a weekly schedule all year, independent of fishing seasons, with a consistent 2–3 kg grade. Harvested, cleaned and blast-frozen on site in Gran Canaria, shipped by refrigerated sea-and-road freight to a Madrid cold store, delivered Tuesday mornings.
experiences.location: Las Palmas de Gran Canaria, Spain

experiences.name: Huerta Galaica – Cachelos Potatoes 12-Month Supply
experiences.description: Galician waxy potatoes for cachelos, the boiled potato base served alongside pulpo a feira. Grown in A Limia, Ourense, and stored in a climate-controlled warehouse so quality holds between harvests. About 300 kg per month on a 12-month fixed-price agreement, delivered weekly in 25 kg sacks.

experiences.name: Costa Occidental Pescados – Pot & Trap-Caught Octopus Annual Contract
experiences.description: Year-round contract for whole frozen octopus sized 2–3 kg each, about 100 kg monthly, with the price per kg held for 12 months. Wild adult Octopus vulgaris caught at sea in pots and traps off western Asturias and the Portuguese Algarve; not hatchery-bred or tank-reared. Drawing on two fishing regions with different closure periods keeps volume steady. Frozen after landing at Avilés and Olhão, consolidated at a cold store near Madrid, and delivered weekly by refrigerated truck in vacuum-packed single pieces.

experiences.name: Setas del Tajo – King Oyster Mushroom Supply
experiences.description: Cultivated king oyster mushrooms with thick, meaty stems that slice and sear much like octopus, a popular base for a plant-based “pulpo” tapa. Grown indoors on straw substrate near Toledo and harvested to order, with a 12-month fixed price. Delivered twice weekly in 5 kg crates.

experiences.name: Distribuciones Meseta Mar – Tank-Reared Octopus 12-Month Supply
experiences.description: Madrid-based distribution of whole frozen octopus from a Canary Islands production facility, where the octopus is reared for its full life cycle in shared indoor tanks rather than caught at sea. Uniform 2–3 kg grading in every shipment, a guaranteed monthly volume and one fixed price across the 12-month contract. Stock is held at a Mercamadrid cold store and delivered weekly by refrigerated van, each piece vacuum-packed and labelled with batch and freezing date.

experiences.name: Despensa Vera – Pimentón, Salt & Olive Oil Contract
experiences.description: Everything needed to dress pulpo a feira in one monthly order: sweet and hot pimentón de la Vera smoked over oak in Cáceres province, flaky sea salt, and Arbequina extra-virgin olive oil from Lleida in 5 L tins. Pricing is fixed for 12 months, with a single consolidated delivery each month.
